title.zh: 界面耦合：氧化层既阻挡也改变扩散
title.en: Interface coupling: oxide both blocks and changes diffusion

subtitle.zh: 氧化层阻挡 / 界面偏聚 /点缺陷注入/表面损失
subtitle.en: Oxide blocking / interface segregation / point-defect injection / surface loss

body.zh: 氧化层不只是掩膜；氧化与界面状态还会改变界面附近的扩散行为。
body.en: Oxide is more than a mask; oxidation and interface condition also modify near-interface diffusion.

body.zh: 从氧化层制备到近界面验证，界面效应贯穿整个过程
body.en: Interface effects span the entire sequence from oxide preparation to near-interface verification
as a mask or surface layer
point defects and inject them into silicon

body.zh: 界面耦合机理（放大示意）
掺杂原子在氧化层表面到达后，发生阻挡、偏聚、进入硅以及点缺陷注入等多种行为
body.en: Dopants arriving at the oxide surface undergo blocking, segregation, entry into silicon and point-defect injection

body.zh: 氧化层、气氛、界面状态和掺杂元素共同决定界面行为
body.en: Oxide, ambient, interface condition and dopant species jointly determine interface behavior

body.zh: 氧化层既能阻挡和保护，也会改变扩散与损失
body.en: Oxide blocks and protects, while also changing diffusion and loss
• Protect the surface and reduce damage

body.zh: • 改变点缺陷的生成与分布

body.en: • Generate interface defects, affecting electrical behavior

body.zh: 通过结构、剖面和电性分析，识别界面相关问题
body.en: Identify interface-related problems through structure, profile and electrical analyses

body.zh: 量测提醒（非独立闭环，仅为本页内嵌）
body.en: Measurement reminder (embedded here, not a separate feedback loop)
or thin oxide allow dopant penetration

body.zh: 或被捕获，导致有效剂量降低 / 影响迁移率和可靠性
body.en: or capture reduces effective dose / affects mobility and reliability

body.zh: 界面效应的增强、抑制和偏聚方向取决于掺杂元素与具体工艺条件，不做普适化结论。
body.en: Whether interface effects enhance, suppress or segregate dopants depends on the species and specific process conditions; do not generalize.
